title: voxweave segmentation corpus registry
description: Registry of the tracked segmentation golden cases. Case paths are relative to the registry file, must be unique and must not escape it. Loader semantics on top of this schema: every referenced case exists and validates against segmentation-case.schema.json, the per-language case counts match required_counts exactly, every entry of required_tags is covered by at least one case, no single case file exceeds 256 KB, the tracked corpus total stays under 3 MB, and the corpus digest is recomputed from the registry plus every case. Any violation is exit code 2, not a quality failure.
